text:
For everyday spending, Monzo is the best all-round pick if you want an easy-to-use app, spending notifications and fee-free spending abroad; Which? gives it an 85% customer score. If you’d rather earn cashback, consider Chase: it offers 2% on eligible everyday purchases, but you must make 15+ card purchases monthly and keep at least £1,000 in Chase savings to qualify.
